summary: In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus is still at work on his contraption. You have brought him the Frost Oil from Coolant Heads Prevail, but one small part is missing: a gyrochronatom.

sections.title: A Crucial Part
sections.body:
Lotwil Veriatus is so caught up in his work that he praises you for doing the job beyond all standards. Then he says you may apply for work if you meet him in Kharanos.

A hurried scramble follows as Lotwil tries to catch hold of something. Then he asks for a gyrochronatom. The part is small but crucial, and with it the project should be ready to complete.

sections.title: Handing It Over
sections.body: Lotwil Veriatus seizes the gyrochronatom with a shout when you hand it over. The work is nearly done, he says, and the project is his top priority. His promise to finish soon stretches from a few minutes to perhaps much longer.

faq.q: Who is asking for the gyrochronatom?
faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus is working on a contraption in the Badlands and asks you for a gyrochronatom.

faq.q: What does Lotwil Veriatus need the gyrochronatom for?
faq.answer: The gyrochronatom is a small but crucial part of Lotwil Veriatus's project. With it, he should be ready to complete the work.

faq.q: What is the offer about Kharanos?
faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus says you may apply for work if you meet him in Kharanos.

faq.q: Where can a gyrochronatom be found?
faq.answer: Engineers make gyrochronatoms, and engineering suppliers sell them.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can make a gyrochronatom yourself.
